The comment reverses suffix order in its alternative names. The respective ListedLicense IDs supply their exact spelling.

limitations: The generated header is documentary evidence. Only a work’s authorized notice establishes its grant and designations. Preserve that notice separately from the publisher’s license document.
The reviewed bytes are SPDX JSON-LD. Exact GNU publisher bytes and a match to any particular work were unverified.
